performance.verdict: ROAS collapse is real; last 6 days show zero purchases and zero GBP signal.

findings.text: ROAS crashed 79.18% week-over-week; last 6 days (Aug 14–19) show 0 purchases on $313.54 spend — revenue generation has fully stalled.
3-day purchase signal (Aug 17–19): 3 purchases total vs 6 in prior 3 days (Aug 14–16), but Aug 18–19 are both zero — momentum is gone, not recovering.
SOW OVERDUE: Live-Cooking Event Shoot 1 was due Aug 14 and has no completed event recorded — fresh creative pipeline is blocked at this milestone.
GBP actions dropped to 0 for Aug 17–19 (vs 14–23/day earlier in July) — organic purchase intent has also collapsed, amplifying the paid-channel signal.

Top campaign 'BWS - Muslim Subscription Box' consumed $849.52 of 28-day spend (57%) but the 6-day zero-purchase streak suggests creative fatigue on the Muslim-audience pool — consistent with the July frequency burn-out pattern.

suggestions.text: Hold current spend; do not scale BWS campaign until purchases resume for 3 consecutive days.
suggestions.monday_update: Six consecutive days of $0 revenue on $313.54 spend (Aug 14–19) makes scaling indefensible right now. Hold daily budget flat at ~$52/day and monitor for 3 consecutive purchase days before any increase. Success check: 3 purchases in 3 days by 2026-08-23; if not reached, escalate to creative refresh. Re-check Aug 23.

suggestions.text: Inject new real-footage creative into BWS campaign to break probable fatigue on the Muslim-audience pool.
